attributes.name: Wheellock Pistol
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d6. You may additionally bury this card to add another 1d10. If you did not bury this card, roll 1d6, or 1d12 if proficient with weapons. On 1-3, shuffle this card into your deck.

Recharge this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by another character at your location.
